children: The Saudi Arabia-based Al Rajhi Capital has appointed JP Morgan alum Mounir Chahine as its new Director of Investment Banking to lead growth in M&A transactions.
Chahine will report to Al Rajhi Capital’s Head of Investment Banking, Usman Sikandar.
He has joined the investment banking subsidiary of Alrajhi Bank after 15 years at JP Morgan in London and Paris, where he advised clients on M&A and private equity deals.
(Writing by Bindu Rai, editing by Seban Scaria)

title: Saudi’s Al Rajhi Capital appoints new Director of Investment Banking
